name: Veterano V4 Reimaginado
role: Quarta opção da rodada PixelLab + Aseprite; releitura do Orc Warrior V4

appearance.face: Releitura de V4: face madura, sobrancelha marcada, presas curtas e olhos âmbar
appearance.lighting: Candidato PixelLab inspirado nos valores da V4

outfit.description: Armadura funcional de ferro escuro, ombreira metálica assimétrica, lenço carmim, tiras de couro e cinto largo.

profile.note: Estudo conceitual candidato; formato de sprite de jogo ainda depende de validação.

reuseAssessment.evidence: New PixelLab generation in a blank Aseprite canvas; the creator requested one V4-inspired option.
reuseAssessment.adaptation: Retain selected visual cues while redesigning the rendering and silhouette; no source pixels pasted.
reuseAssessment.artRisk: Model may reproduce V4 too literally or flatten its distinctive shapes.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: Generated concept may need cleanup before any production sprite use.
reuseAssessment.productionImpact: Candidate comparison only; no production or Unity assets replaced.

reuseAssessment.adaptation: Use V4 olive, crimson, dark iron and controlled silver palette cues as PixelLab guidance.
reuseAssessment.artRisk: Palette may overwhelm the new silhouette.
reuseAssessment.technicalRisk: No runtime impact at concept stage.
reuseAssessment.productionImpact: No active recipe or approval changes.
